name: Save the Cat
description: Blake Snyder's 15-beat plot sheet in three acts. Act I sets up the hook and dilemma; Act II fun and games builds the promise of the premise through the midpoint and dark night; Act III finale and final image resolve the theme.

children.title: Opening Image
children.synopsis: A snapshot of the protagonist's world before the story changes it.

scenes.title: Before
scenes.synopsis: Establish tone and a sense of who the protagonist is now.

children.title: Theme Stated
children.synopsis: A hint of the story's central theme or lesson, stated early.

scenes.title: The Hint
scenes.synopsis: A line or moment seeds what the journey will teach.

children.title: Set-up
children.synopsis: Introduce the cast, the wants, and the flawed status quo.

scenes.title: The Cast
scenes.synopsis: Show relationships and the everyday lacking behind the surface.

children.title: Catalyst
children.synopsis: A sudden event knocks the status quo off its rails.

scenes.title: The Tipping Event
scenes.synopsis: The ordinary world is upended and the story moves.

children.title: Debate
children.synopsis: The protagonist questions the road ahead, weighing the leap.

scenes.title: The Question
scenes.synopsis: Can I? Should I? Doubt sharpens the choice.

children.title: Break into Two
children.synopsis: The protagonist leaves the old world and commits to the new.

scenes.title: The Choice Made
scenes.synopsis: Action, not speech, begins Act Two.

children.title: B Story
children.synopsis: A subplot that shadows the theme, often a relationship.

scenes.title: The Second Thread
scenes.synopsis: A connection opens, commenting on the main story.

children.title: Fun and Games
children.synopsis: The promise of the premise: the audience savors what the concept delivers.

scenes.title: The Payoff Play
scenes.synopsis: Playful, vibrant scenes of the new world in full swing.

children.title: Midpoint
children.synopsis: A major shift raises the stakes; the protagonist gains or loses ground.

scenes.title: The Turn
scenes.synopsis: Revelation or defeat transforms the trajectory.

children.title: Bad Guys Close In
children.synopsis: The opposition tightens and internal fractures surface.

scenes.title: The Squeeze
scenes.synopsis: Everything starts coming apart at once.

children.title: All Is Lost
children.synopsis: A false victory collapses; the protagonist loses something vital.

children.title: Dark Night of the Soul
children.synopsis: The protagonist hits bottom and is forced to see clearly.

scenes.title: The Low Point
scenes.synopsis: Despair yields a hard truth or renewed resolve.

children.title: Break into Three
children.synopsis: A new idea or a helping hand sparks the final plan.

scenes.title: The Spark
scenes.synopsis: The protagonist rises with a fresh approach.

children.title: Finale
children.synopsis: The plan plays out; beats pay off in order; the goal is resolved.

scenes.title: The Payoff
scenes.synopsis: Stakes, theme, and old hurts collide in the climax.

children.title: Final Image
children.synopsis: A mirror of the opening image, showing the change.

scenes.title: After
scenes.synopsis: A resonant vision of the transformed protagonist.
